articles.summary: The Doctors Company today announced that Deepika Srivastava, Chief Operating Officer, has been appointed to the Medical Professional Liability Association (MPL Association) Board of Directors.
articles.title: Deepika Srivastava, Chief Operating Officer of The Doctors Company, Appointed to MPL Association Board of Directors

articles.summary: The Doctors Company, the nation’s largest physician-owned medical malpractice insurer, announced today that it has completed the acquisition of ProAssurance Corporation (NYSE: PRA), a specialty insurer with broad expertise in medical liability, products liability for medical technology and life sciences companies, and workers’ compensation insurance.
articles.title: The Doctors Company Completes Acquisition of ProAssurance Corporation

articles.summary: The Doctors Company announced new leadership appointments to strengthen its medical professional liability (MPL) operations, support growth, and position the organization for continued success.
articles.title: The Doctors Company Strengthens MPL Leadership With Key Appointments

articles.summary: The Doctors Company, the nation’s largest physician-owned medical malpractice insurer, part of TDC Group, announced today the appointment of Akhil Saklecha, MD, MBA, FACEP, and Owen Garrick, MD, MBA, to its Board of Governors.
articles.title: The Doctors Company Appoints Akhil Saklecha, MD, and Owen Garrick, MD, to Its Board of Governors

articles.title: Mark the Calendar for ASHRM 2026!
